prompt: A weathered druid in deep emerald and moss-green robes kneels in a low crouch at the edge of an old-growth forest, facing south-east, one bare weathered hand outstretched and beckoning. A great antlered stag with coarse brown fur steps out of the dark treeline toward the druids open hand, head lowered, answering the call. Soft green motes of magical light drift between the druids fingers and the approaching beast. The background is a dense, shadowed forest of towering moss-slicked trunks, dappled with pale green light filtering through the canopy.
